single_target: every solve is one cold solve of one public Q; no multi-target amortisation (owner instruction)
seed_derivation: unchanged #5253 seeds.rs: seed(parts) = first 8 bytes big-endian of SHA-256('bcr-20261126/v1|' + '|'.join(parts)); stream = SplitMix64(seed); uniform below m by rejection. The study prefix stays bcr-20261126/v1 so that curves, targets and target streams are bitwise those of #5253.
custody: d drawn from the 'target' stream inside the evaluator; solvers receive (curve, G, Q, ell); [d]G = Q checked inside the counted solve; d == d_true compared by the evaluator after the solve

arms.D: Gaudry-Diem k=3 Weil descent of symmetric S4 to K' = F_{2^n'}, elimination to U(t), deg <= 20, subfield root finding gcd(U', t^q' + t), exact lift and cubic split; A1 stream, A2 echelon LA; bwd_harness (this study)
arms.F: #5253 tuned factored S4 root finder (pairs-and-solve), reused records data/runs_a2.jsonl, panel only
arms.M2: #5253 m=2 hash MITM; panel: reused records data/runs_a2.jsonl; extension n=36,39: #5253 binary unchanged
arms.RHO: #5253 negation-map rho, 16 seeds per target; panel: reused records data/runs.jsonl; extension: #5253 binary unchanged with lanes below

rho_lanes_choice: argmin of mean Meq(s=1,u=1) over W in {1,2,4,8,16,32,64} on 2 held-out pilot curves x 16 pilot targets per rung (data/pilot_rho_ext.jsonl), same rule as #5253; W = 64 (the grid edge) won at every extension rung; panel rungs keep #5253's lanes

resources.rule: a killed/failed process is a resource-limit record, never a negative result; the run continues with the next rung

primary_metric: Meq(s=1,u=1) of the whole cold solve (factor base, setup, target stream, oracle, relation replay, LA, [d]G = Q); #5253 unit unchanged
band: u in {0, 0.1, 1} for non-field units, s in {1, 0.25}; order between arms stated only where it holds across the band (AGENTS.md 5a)
analysis: bwd_harness analyze: paired per-case ratios D/rho, F/rho, M2/rho (rho = mean of 16 runs on the same Q), D/F, D/M2; per-rung geometric mean with hierarchical bootstrap B=10000 (2000 for band); rho A/A (seeds 0-7 vs 8-15); exponent fits; D census; crossover projection (model, PROTOCOL.md)

checks.group_law_replay: every D decomposition resolved into signs by the group law before it becomes a row
checks.D_eq_bruteforce: per rung brute_targets per case (exhaustive multiset x signs group-law enumeration)
checks.D_identical_to_F_record: (d, targets, relations, columns) of D equals #5253 A2 F record on every panel case
checks.logs: [d]G = Q in-solve and d == d_true, every solve
checks.replay: n=30 ci=0 ti=0 rerun from the frozen manifest, bitwise compare of all counts

hypotheses.H1: D's decomposition sets equal F's and the exhaustive group-law sets on every checked target; D reproduces F's (d, targets, relations, columns) on all 64 panel cases; every log correct
hypotheses.H2: oracle Meq per target linear in n', within 1.5e3..6e3 over n' = 6..16; mean deg U' = 16
hypotheses.H3: panel: 10 <= D/rho <= 100 at every rung (no parity); D/F <= 1e-2 for n >= 24; D/M2 > 1 at n = 18 and < 1 from some rung in 27..33
hypotheses.H4: D relation-phase slope (log2 cost on log2 ell) in 0.33..0.45; D total slope > 0.5 once echelon LA dominates; LA share > 0.5 from n = 42
hypotheses.H5: model: full-base D never crosses rho (LA >= F^2); relation phase alone would cross at n' ~ 22..26; balanced base ratio ~ sqrt(10 kappa c_D h)/S ~ 50, no crossing; only double large prime (exponent 4/3) could cross, not measured

falsifier: parity at a rung if the upper 95% bound of D/rho <= 1 there; such a rung then requires the rho A/A floor and full verification before it is stated
exclusions: none; every record, failure, kill and mismatch is retained
untested: Koblitz rungs (subfield base projects to O, #5253)
